metadata.body:
## Summary The common tokenizer reads `//` and the rest of the line as a line comment before the JSX reader sees element text. In element text such as a URL, the closing tag ended up inside the comment token, the element never closed, and the functions after it were lost. This is a regression in 1.26.0: 1.25.0 read these files correctly. ```diff XMLTagWithAttrTokenizer (element children) - "//..." -> line comment, swallows "

;" + while reading element text: "//" is text, the rest of the line is read again ``` Changes are in `lizard_languages/tsx.py`, with tests in `test/test_languages/testTSX.py`. ## Evidence ```jsx function Card() { return

Visit https://example.com today

; } function after(a) { return a ? 1 : 2; } ``` - **Before** (master `f9323a80`): one function, swallowing the second. ``` 5 2 14 0 6 Card@1-6@url.jsx ``` **After:** two functions with their own lines. ``` 3 1 7 0 3 Card@1-3@url.jsx 3 2 12 1 3 after@4-6@url.jsx ``` - Test suite (excluding `test_website*.py`, which needs Flask): master 3077 passed, 29 failed; this branch 3078 passed, with the same 29 failures. The new test fails on master. ## Merge Danger **Door:** two-way **Blast Radius:** JSX/TSX Only text inside JSX element children is affected; `//` in code and in `{...}` child expressions is still a comment.
